biotools.summary: The PTB-XL ECG dataset is a large, publicly available resource containing 21801 clinical 12-lead ECGs from 18869 patients, annotated by cardiologists and accompanied by rich metadata. It is used for training and evaluating arrhythmia detection algorithms.
